action: Customers who reuse a Hugendubel password elsewhere should change it, enable two-factor authentication, check account statements and be wary of phishing emails posing as Hugendubel (netzwelt's advice).
date_note: netzwelt says the attack happened in the night to 19 November; its article is dated 21 November.
exec: A bookseller's online shop, e-book downloads and cloud were disrupted after a reported cyberattack; per heise, Hugendubel's site says restoring systems may take several days.
plain: German bookseller Hugendubel's online shop, Tolino Cloud and eBook.de were unreachable after a reported cyberattack. Per heise, Hugendubel says no sensitive or personal customer data is affected as of now.

sources.name: Caschys Blog (stadt-bremerhaven.de): Hugendubel: Cyberangriff legt Online-Shop und tolino-Downloads lahm
retail-news.de: Cyberattacke auf Hugendubel legt Onlineshop und digitale Buchdienste lahm
Blogspan: Hugendubel: Tolino-Cloud nach Cyberangriff offline
heise Security: Nach Cyberangriff: Hugendubel, Tolino-Cloud und eBook.de gestört

summary: According to heise, Hugendubel says on Instagram it was the target of a cyberattack in the night to 19 November; its websites cite a technical fault. heise reports the Hugendubel shop, Tolino Cloud and eBook.de in maintenance mode and eBook downloads unavailable, and Hugendubel's site says it may take several days to restore systems. Hugendubel says no sensitive or personal customer data is affected as of now.
title: Hugendubel online shop and Tolino Cloud offline after reported cyberattack

validation.note: Four publishers (netzwelt, Caschys Blog, retail-news.de, heise) state the attack in the night to 19 Nov; Hugendubel statements (Instagram, its website) are relayed by heise and others, not read directly.

review.note: Compared title, 19 Nov night, several days, no sensitive data, services and advice against heise and netzwelt
